title: ecoinvent biosphere3 elementary flows → Eaternity BAFU-extension flows
description: Contributed by Eaternity (PR #7). Target datasource is eaternity-bafu-ext: Eaternity's provisional BAFU-2026-based instance with sub-compartments collapsed and extension substances added, keyed by Eaternity's native codes (same code space as the rank-5 sources). It is not bafu-2026-v1: 1,185 of the 1,371 targets resolve by name, root compartment and unit to a BAFU-2026 v1 flow, the rest are Eaternity extension flows. The bafu-2026-v1 → ef-3.1 entries derivable from this bridge (via the retained biosphere3 sub-compartment and characterization-factor identity) are produced by sentier-importers into a separate ranked bridge. 99 speciation-changing candidates are listed in the non-normative speciation_candidates.json.
